content.user_title: Review and Clean Up WebAsk Survey Responses
content.value_statement: Test submissions and duplicate responses can distort survey reports and complicate follow-up. This skill guides preview-based WebAsk cleanup with reversible hiding, response tags, and explicit approval before deletion.
actual_capabilities: Preview filtered responses with counts, date ranges, and selection criteria before requesting deletion approval.
Group potential test submissions, unusually fast responses, repeated answer patterns, and duplicate contacts for review.
Guide reversible hiding, moving responses to trash, restoring trashed responses, and explicitly approved permanent deletion through WebAsk tools.
Add response notes and tags, reuse existing account tags, and manage the account tag directory.
Set the question display order within response cards.
limitations: Requires an available WebAsk MCP connection and permission to use the referenced tools.
Permanent deletion cannot be undone; restoration applies only to responses retained in trash.
Cleanup indicators identify candidates for human review, not proof that a response is invalid.
Provides workflow instructions and tool dependencies, not the underlying MCP server implementation.

use_cases.title: Review Responses After Survey Launch
use_cases.description: Identify submissions collected before launch and preview them before hiding confirmed test responses from reports.

use_cases.title: Organize Customer Follow-Up
use_cases.description: Tag complaint responses and add callback notes while preserving the original responses in survey statistics.

use_cases.title: Review Duplicate Contacts
use_cases.description: Group repeated phone numbers or email addresses and agree on cleanup criteria before changing responses.

prompt_templates.title: Preview Test Submissions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review survey [survey] for responses submitted before [launch date]. Show candidate counts, dates, and selection criteria without making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Review Duplicate Contacts
prompt_templates.prompt: Find repeated [phone or email] values in survey [survey] during [date range]. Group candidates and propose reversible hiding for my approval.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Follow-Up Labels
prompt_templates.prompt: In account [account], review existing tags for survey [survey]. Tag complaint responses with [tag] and add [note], preserving their visibility in reports.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: organize responses for customer follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Staged Cleanup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review survey [survey] during [date range] for tests, fast completions, repeated patterns, and duplicate contacts. Report separate counts and criteria without changing data. Propose reversible actions and await my approval for the exact scope. Exclude low ratings as a cleanup criterion.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate several review criteria with explicit approval.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Review prelaunch responses and repeated phone numbers without changing anything.
output: Prelaunch candidates: 18 responses collected September 3-6, before the September 7 launch.
Duplicate-contact candidates: 9 responses with repeated phone numbers.
These are review groups, not confirmed invalid responses.
No responses changed. Review the selected responses before approving reversible hiding.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Can you restore responses I permanently deleted?
output: Permanently deleted responses cannot be restored through this workflow.
Responses still in trash can be restored.
Specify the survey and response scope so I can check what remains available.

best_practices: Review candidate counts, dates, and selection criteria before approving any deletion.
Start with reversible hiding when response validity is uncertain.
Check existing account tags before creating new labels.
anti_patterns: Permanently deleting responses without explicit approval for the exact scope.
Removing low ratings or valid outliers to improve reported metrics.
Creating duplicate account tags without checking the existing directory.

faq.question: Does the skill delete responses immediately?
faq.answer: No. It instructs the assistant to preview the selected responses and obtain approval before deletion.

faq.question: Can deleted responses be recovered?
faq.answer: Responses moved to trash can be restored. Permanently deleted responses cannot be recovered through this workflow.

faq.question: What cleanup indicators does it consider?
faq.answer: It considers prelaunch submissions, unusually fast completions, repetitive answer patterns, and duplicate contact details. These indicators require human review.

faq.question: Will tags remove responses from statistics?
faq.answer: No. Tags label responses while retaining them in statistics. Hiding is a separate operation.

faq.question: Are response tags specific to one survey?
faq.answer: The tag directory belongs to the account. The skill uses the account identifier and checks existing tags before creating new ones.

faq.question: What is required to use this skill?
faq.answer: Use Claude, Codex, or Claude Code with the referenced WebAsk MCP tools configured. The skill does not supply the MCP server.
